issues.failure_explanation: Ignoring rounding, the allocation equalizes sigma_j raised to the allocated iteration count, not actual errors. The paper itself establishes that complex shifts can have strictly smaller decay factors than sigma_j. As the budget grows, their achieved errors can therefore become arbitrarily smaller relative to those of a real shift, even for endpoint eigenvector errors. Only a heuristic balance of modeled upper-bound exponents is established.
